securities.name: TrimTabs
securities.quote: Share buybacks in 2018 have averaged $4.8 billion a day, double the pace for the same period last year, according to market data firm TrimTabs.

securities.name: J. P. Morgan
securities.quote: J. P. Morgan recently predicted that share repurchases would total about $800 billion this year, a new record.

securities.name: Bank of America Merrill Lynch
securities.quote: The share repurchases have helped keep the market afloat, as investors have pulled $23.5 billion out of funds that focus on U.S. stocks this year, according to Bank of America Merrill Lynch.

securities.name: David Santschi
securities.quote: "The feverish buyback activity suggests companies plan to use a hefty chunk of the money they expect to save on taxes to buy back stock," David Santschi, director of liquidity research at TrimTabs, said in his weekly report.
